name: Large uniform families without singleton intersections
description: construct() -> 1..1000 distinct four-element subsets of 0..15. No two members may intersect in exactly one element. Maximize the number of members. The local parameters are n=16 and k=4. The optimum is binomial(14,2) = 91 (Keevash, Mubayi and Wilson determined the maximum for k = 4 and every n >= 9), so this is a rediscovery task.

state_of_the_art.statement: Keevash, Mubayi and Wilson determined the maximum for 4-uniform families and every n. For n >= 9 it is binomial(n-2, 2), attained only by all 4-sets through two fixed points, so the maximum for n = 16 is 91. Frankl proved the bound binomial(n-2, k-2) for all k >= 4 and large n (Erdős Problem #702).
